description: Update parameters on multiple nodes in a single batch request. Each update reports its own success; a failure does not roll back the others.

updates.description: List of { path, parameters } updates sent in one batch request (per-update results; not transactional — a failed update does not roll back the others).

parameters.description: Parameter values to set on that node, as a { parName: value } map.

path.description: Path of the node whose parameters to update.

name: set_parameters_batch
title: Set parameters (batch)
